name: Cadentia Farnese
source:
Roll the dice and discover the history of the iconic Palazzo Farnese: 12 stories as 12 facets of the familiar silhouette that the Romans call the Dice.

Learn about the mysterious ancient mosaics preserved underground. Enter behind the scenes of international diplomacy with the French Embassy, which has had its headquarters at Palazzo Farnese for 150 years. Find the graffiti left by young art students in the 18th century on the walls of the famous Carracci Gallery, uncovered during a recent restoration, and much more!

Are you ready to roll the dice? 

[From [url=https://wearemuesli.itch.io/farnese]itch.io[/url]]
